environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'services' with IRSA role arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/webhook-service-role-prod. DynamoDB table 'webhook_events' has a leading-key condition on the IAM policy: dynamodb:LeadingKeys condition restricts PutItem/UpdateItem to items where pk begins with the tenant ID extracted from the OIDC token's sub claim (condition: 'ForAllValues:StringLike' on 'dynamodb:LeadingKeys' matching '${aws:PrincipalTag/tenant_id}'). The 'tenants' table GetItem is restricted via dynamodb:LeadingKeys to only the authenticated tenant's partition. Pod runs on nodes with IMDSv2 enforced (HttpTokens=required, hop-limit=1) meaning the pod cannot reach IMDS since container network adds an extra hop. Calico NetworkPolicy applied with spec.egress limited to CIDR 10.0.0.0/8 for DynamoDB VPC endpoint and specific external webhook domains via a DNS-based egress policy (GlobalNetworkPolicy 'webhook-egress-allowlist' matching domains from ConfigMap 'allowed-callback-domains'). The Calico policy explicitly denies egress to 169.254.169.254/32 and fd00:ec2::254/128.

config.calico_network_policy: webhook-egress-allowlist: egress to 10.0.0.0/8 (VPC endpoint) + DNS-matched domains from ConfigMap; explicit deny 169.254.169.254/32 and link-local
config.dynamodb_vpc_endpoint: vpce-0abc123def456 with policy restricting to tables tenants and webhook_events
